families.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

members.gloss: having or marked by confidence or assurance
members.tone: The plain baseline of the family, reporting that the assurance is there without passing any verdict on whether it is warranted.

members.gloss: marked by assurance; exhibiting confidence
members.tone: Shifts from the inner state to the visible one, crediting a confidence you can see in the bearing where *confident* merely records it.

members.gloss: marked by excessive confidence
members.tone: Jeering and informal - the excess is not diagnosed but mocked, a swagger the word refuses to take seriously beside the flat *overconfident*.

members.gloss: marked by excessive confidence
members.tone: The straight clinical name for the fault, marking the confidence as more than warranted and leaving the derision to *cocksure*.

members.gloss: marked by excessive confidence
members.tone: The mildest word for too much confidence: an everyday word that lets the excess come across as a shrug, not an accusation.

members.gloss: having confidence restored; freed from anxiety
members.tone: The settled calm of confidence handed back as worry lifts, where the rest of the family never mentions it having been shaken.

flagged_for.sentence: never mentions it having been shaken

members.gloss: showing poise and confidence in your own worth
members.tone: Turns the poise inward onto one's own worth and lets it show as composure, steadier-sounding than the bare *confident*.

members.gloss: showing poise and confidence in your own worth
members.tone: The plainest label for that same belief in one's own worth, stating it where *self-assured* leans on the outward steadiness.

families.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

members.gloss: not diminished or moderated in intensity or severity; sometimes used as an intensifier
members.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Openly scornful, not just total - it sneers at the very thing it strengthens, where *complete* only measures it.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Makes the quality total as if it were a finished achievement, and that mismatch gives it a dry humour *utter* lacks.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Adds a fed-up annoyance, insisting the quality never lets up, where *utter* simply states how far it goes.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: The most deliberate of these, spelling out that nothing was mixed in to weaken the quality, where *pure* says it in a breath.

families.axis: a plain count of years → age as infirmity worth mocking

members.gloss: (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
members.tone: Flat and neutral, it covers both a long life lived and simply a stated age reached, where *of age* means only the second.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: Formal and weighty, it presents advanced years as a settled state, where *older* only marks a point on a scale.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: The courteous way to say advanced in years, gentler in force than *aged* and careful to claim nothing further about the person.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: An *-er* form used as plain description, which makes it the softest word here: it suggests a scale rather than naming a state.

members.gloss: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
members.tone: Carries a note of standing rather than decline, making it the one flattering way in this set to say advanced in years.

members.gloss: having attained a specific age; (‘aged’ is pronounced as one syllable)
members.tone: Purely a threshold reached, with none of the weight of accumulated years that *aged* brings with it.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: Puts age in motion rather than in place - the process, not the state - and that forward motion carries its faint edge of decline.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: The British spelling of the same word, carrying the identical sense of decline already under way.

members.gloss: growing old
members.tone: Clinical and detached: the same growing old as *aging*, in a style that feels nothing about it.

members.gloss: very old
members.tone: Pure intensification — *old* taken to its limit, and the size of the exaggeration is what gives it its edge.

members.gloss: of or like a feeble old woman
members.tone: Formal-sounding but withering, covering both being a feeble old woman and merely being like one; the scorn is in the word itself.

members.gloss: being at least 100 years old
members.tone: Purely quantitative — it fixes a number where *ancient* only gestures at extremity, and passes no verdict with it.

members.gloss: (of fabrics and paper) grown dark in color over time
members.tone: The only word here about what time does to the colour of cloth or paper, not to a life, and it judges nothing.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: Scornful where *aged* is not: weakness of mind or body from age becomes the whole of what it says about the person.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: The same judgement of weakness from age as *doddering*, but the shorter form makes the mockery sound casual rather than deliberate.

members.gloss: mentally or physically infirm with age
members.tone: Informal and blunt - the same weakness from age as *doddering*, in a word too jokey to leave the person any dignity.

families.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

members.gloss: not pleased; experiencing or manifesting displeasure
members.tone: The coolest word here: it names a lack of pleasure, felt or shown, without any heat in it.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: The plain, unheated name for the state: impatience or anger without the colouring that *miffed* or *steamed* add to it.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Friction rather than flare: the same impatience or anger, but felt as something rubbing on and on rather than landing once like *stung*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Light: it treats the feeling as a small thing and the person as easily upset, where *annoyed* judges neither.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Prickled and smarting: the state as something that caught and stings still, sharper in point than *annoyed* and briefer than *irritated*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Small and faintly comic, it scales the impatience or anger down to a grievance worth mentioning but not worth raising your voice over.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Rude and blunt: the crudest way in this group to say it, and everything *displeased* holds back.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Carries the coarse charge of *pissed* with the particle adding follow-through, anger sent outward rather than merely held.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Stirred up rather than simply arrived at: it puts the impatience or anger down to having been worked into someone.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Churning, not flaring: the feeling is muddy and unsettled all through, where *stung* is one sharp point.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Pressure made visible, the heat contained but plainly building, hotter than *peeved* and short of the coarseness of *pissed off*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Something landed, and the feeling is the sudden pull back from it, where *irritated* only wears on.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: The end of the line, annoyance carried far enough that patience is spent, which is exactly what *annoyed* still holds in reserve.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: British, and it takes the drama out: patience fully lost, in a phrase too casual to shout, where *exasperated* keeps its calm.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: Flat, worn British informality, the patience gone by erosion rather than blown out like *steamed*.

members.gloss: having a strong distaste from surfeit
members.tone: Strong dislike from having had too much of something - the stomach turning, not anger aimed at anyone.

families.axis: harm merely reported → damage shown in graphic bodily detail

members.gloss: harmed
members.tone: The flat report that harm was done, holding back every picture of it that *mangled* insists on showing.

members.gloss: scarred by battle
members.tone: Here the marks stand as proof of what was come through, so the damage reads as standing earned rather than harm suffered.

members.gloss: discolored by coagulation of blood beneath the skin
members.tone: Names the bruise by its two colours, homely and concrete beside the graver *livid*.

members.gloss: discolored by coagulation of blood beneath the skin
members.tone: The same bruising, but heavy and grim, as if something has gone badly wrong under the skin, where *black-and-blue* stays almost homely.

members.gloss: separated at the joint
members.tone: Structural and bloodless: the joint has come apart, and the word says nothing at all about pain.

members.gloss: separated at the joint
members.tone: The exact term for a joint driven out of place, diagnostic where *disjointed* sounds merely come-apart.

members.gloss: separated at the joint
members.tone: The barest statement of the same parting at the joint — it neither winces nor diagnoses.

members.gloss: having been disembowelled
members.tone: The most graphic member: the body opened and emptied, damage gone past anything that could still be called a wound.

members.gloss: suffering from physical injury especially that suffered in battle
members.tone: The softest word here for real physical injury: it carries its lean toward battle lightly and shows nothing of the wound.

flagged_for.figure: carries its lean toward battle lightly

members.gloss: suffering from physical injury especially that suffered in battle
members.tone: Graver and more formal than *hurt* for the same injury, dignifying the damage and letting the battlefield sit close without shutting out other harm.

members.gloss: having edges that are jagged from injury
members.tone: The clipped form for flesh left with jagged edges, cool in shape even though the picture it raises is not.

members.gloss: having edges that are jagged from injury
members.tone: The ordinary *-ed* form for that same ragged tearing, felt rather than measured, where *lacerate* stays curt.

members.gloss: having edges that are jagged from injury
members.tone: The most violent of these: the jagged edges read as wreckage, the thing ruined rather than merely cut.

members.gloss: having edges that are jagged from injury
members.tone: The plainest word for a ragged injured edge — it names the tearing and stops, where *mangled* piles on ruin.

members.gloss: having the surface exposed and painful
members.tone: Reports pain where the jagged-edge words report shape: the covering is gone, leaving what lies under it exposed and stinging.

families.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

members.gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
members.tone: Lofty praise - credits a penetrating grasp of how things stand in relation, where *judgment* only names the faculty.

members.gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
members.tone: The same commendation built plainly off the adjective, heavier in the mouth than *sagacity* and less polished for it.

members.gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
members.tone: The flat name for the ability to tell relations apart, stating the capacity without the admiration *sagacity* loads onto it.

members.gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
members.tone: The flat name for the ability to tell relations apart, saying only that it is there, without the admiration *sagacity* adds.

members.gloss: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
members.tone: Praise pitched at fineness - the stress falls on discriminating what a coarser mind would run together.

members.gloss: good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
members.tone: Compact and admiring, with 'good' built into the word, and it covers seeing with the eyes or the figurative equivalent alike.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: Approving at the workaday end - soundness in practical matters, the kind expected of anyone rather than marvelled at.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: The bare commendation, with 'good' carrying the whole judgement and no claim past soundness.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: Informal and hearty - the same practical soundness spoken of as a homely possession rather than an intellectual one.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: Informal and blunt, naming what *common sense* names with a grin at its own plainness.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: The barest member - practical soundness in one syllable, with nothing qualifying it.

members.gloss: sound practical judgment
members.tone: Homely and affectionate where *good sense* is flatly commendatory, though the soundness praised is the same.

members.gloss: good judgment
members.tone: Formal praise for judgment that comes out well, not merely for having the faculty at all.

members.gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
members.tone: Praise for a tactful kind of knowing - steering clear of what would embarrass or distress before it arises.

members.gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
members.tone: Mild approval for the knack of heading off embarrassment or distress, a plain quality where *discretion* sounds like a virtue you are praised for.

members.gloss: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
members.tone: Tilts the same skill toward wariness - looking all round a situation for the embarrassment or distress in it.
